candidates.review_note: Stepping strings are closed walks on the digit path0..10 with the initial0 excluded. Odd lengths vanish by bipartiteness. For n=2t, the five nonzero squared eigenvalues are2±sqrt3,3,2,1; subtracting the forbidden endpoint diagonal yields(44a+6b+23*3^t+22*2^t+21)/12 where(2+sqrt3)^t=a+b*sqrt3. Exact quadratic-ring exponentiation handles64-bit lengths and modular division uses gcd-safe inverse12.

Tree DP indexes each subtree by the rank of its root in a valid local linear extension. When merging a child, t child vertices precede the parent root; the edge inequality selects a prefix or suffix of child-root ranks. Binomial factors independently interleave vertices before and after the root. Summing the final root-rank distribution counts every valid ordering once; iterative tree traversal handles long paths.

Reverse the problem order to count nondecreasing chosen values. Compress all range endpoints into intervals where eligibility is constant. Values assigned to one coordinate interval occupy a consecutive block of variables; for block length t and interval size L there are C(L+t-1,t) weakly increasing assignments. Sweep intervals with prefix-count DP, then divide by the product of independent range sizes modulo the stated prime.

Number white cells once in row-major order whenever either the left or upper neighbor is absent/black. Across entries start only at left boundaries and Down entries only at upper boundaries, reusing the same cell number. Single-letter words and entirely black boards are retained; numbering is right-aligned in width3 as required.

A detour outside the ancestor path is dominated by transferring at its LCA because ancestral per-distance prices are no larger and fixed fees are nonnegative. Thus dp(u)=dist(u)P(u)+Q(u)+min_ancestor(dp(v)-dist(v)P(u)). Maintain the lower hull of ancestor lines with decreasing distance slopes. Binary-search both queries and the insertion truncation point, and roll back one overwritten hull slot after each DFS subtree. Equal-distance dominated lines are skipped; no sibling hull leaks across branches.
